newsitem.title: THAILAND: Thai baht firms, interbank eases late.
newsitem.headline: Thai baht firms, interbank eases late.

text.p: The Thai baht tracked a stronger yen in strenthening against the dollar late on Thursday after comments on possible market intervention by Japanese officials, traders said.
The baht was quoted at 26.065/26.085 per dollar late against 26.105/26.110 earlier. The one month swap premium was quoted late at 6.50/7.50 satang/dollar against 6.50/7.00 earlier.
"It was a positive day for the baht, trade was pretty quiet and no-one wanted to take position because they feared intervention," said a dealer at a French bank.
"There were some rumours from speculators in Hong Kong this morning about the military not supporting the Thai government but no one was really buying them," he said.

The Bank of Thailand set the daily baht/dollar midrate at a 10-1/2 year low of 26.10. The baht traded above the midrate early as the dollar surged to 127.10 yen early this morning before its sharp afternoon fall.
Late dollar selling may see the baht gain further on Friday as the greenback is expected to weaken near term, traders said.
"It (the dollar) should hold its support for a while, test the downside first before going back up," he said.
Traders said dollar selling helped ease liquidity as the overnight interbank rate eased to 9.00-9.50 percent late from 9.25-9.75 in the morning.
"Ahead of the long weekend, we expect liquidity to tighten but not many people wanted to take money today. Banks were selling dollar," said a dealer at Siam Commercial Bank.
